context_requirements: Expression of CES1 or BCHE is not sufficient for a transcriptional response; these enzymes act post-translationally on ester-containing substrates and do not directly regulate transcription

A transcriptional response would require the cell to be exposed to a carboxylesterase-activated prodrug or endogenous ester substrate whose active metabolite drives transcription; none is present in this experiment
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Enrichment of a coherent transcriptional program (e.g., proliferation_down, apoptosis, UPR) shared across lines at 24 h

evidence.supports: Carboxylesterase inhibitor DFP blocks cleavage of the ester-linked prodrug AN-152, showing CES inhibition is post-translational and does not itself drive transcription
